        # python interactive-mode but the modules are not compatible with the
        # interactive-mode ("unexpected indent" mainly because of empty lines)

@pytest.mark.parametrize('clixml, expected', [
    ('', ''),
    ('just newline _x000A_', 'just newline \n'),
    ('surrogate pair _xD83C__xDFB5_', 'surrogate pair 🎵'),
    ('null char _x0000_', 'null char \0'),
    ('normal char _x0061_', 'normal char a'),
    ('escaped literal _x005F_x005F_', 'escaped literal _x005F_'),
    ('underscope before escape _x005F__x000A_', 'underscope before escape _\n'),
    ('surrogate high _xD83C_', 'surrogate high \uD83C'),
    ('surrogate low _xDFB5_', 'surrogate low \uDFB5'),
    ('lower case hex _x005f_', 'lower case hex _'),
    ('invalid hex _x005G_', 'invalid hex _x005G_'),
])
def test_parse_clixml_with_comlex_escaped_chars(clixml, expected):
    clixml_data = (

        '<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04">'
        f'<S S="Error">{clixml}</S>'
        '</Objs>'
    ).encode()
    b_expected = expected.encode(errors="surrogatepass")

    actual = _parse_clixml(clixml_data)
    assert actual == b_expected

def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Replace complete CLIXML blocks in stderr without disturbing other bytes."""
    result = bytearray()
    cursor = 0
    search_from = 0
    replaced = False

    while header := _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, search_from):
        start = header.start()
        body_start = header.end()

        # PowerShell can emit the header more than once before the XML body.
        while repeated := _CLIXML_HEADER.match(stderr, body_start):
            body_start = repeated.end()

        xml_start = body_start if stderr.startswith(b"<Objs ", body_start) else -1
        next_header = _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, body_start)
        if xml_start == -1 or (next_header and next_header.start() < xml_start):
            search_from = body_start
            continue

        end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", xml_start)
        if end == -1 or (next_header and next_header.start() < end):
            search_from = body_start
            continue
        end += len(b"</Objs>")

        # A single header may precede several adjacent Objs elements.
        while stderr.startswith(b"<Objs ", end):
            following_end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", end)
            if following_end == -1:
                break
            end = following_end + len(b"</Objs>")

        block = stderr[start:end]
        try:
            try:
                decoded = block.decode("utf-8")
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                decoded = block.decode("cp437")
            replacement = _parse_clixml(decoded.encode("utf-8"))
        except (ET.ParseError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
            search_from = end
            continue

        result.extend(stderr[cursor:start])
        result.extend(replacement)
        replaced = True
        cursor = end
        search_from = end

    if not replaced:
        return stderr
    result.extend(stderr[cursor:])
    return bytes(result)

item.text:
Implemented CLIXML replacement for Windows SSH stderr. Complete blocks are decoded and replaced while surrounding bytes and invalid or incomplete blocks are preserved. The escape regex now matches UTF-16-BE sequences correctly, and the helper falls back to cp437 when UTF-8 decoding fails.

Added coverage for mixed, multiline, repeated, empty, malformed, and cp437 input. All 46 relevant PowerShell and SSH unit tests pass; `git diff --check` passes.
